text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab countries praise France's withdrawal from the allied force protecting Kurds in northern Iraq.
- Arab countries express concern over events in east Sudan.
- Iraqi clergymen urge Moslems and Arabs to support Iraq in fight against U.N. trade sanctions.
- Tunisian newspapers express support for pro-Iraq stands at the U.N. Security Council.
- Trade ministry to distribute additional food rations to low-income groups.
